purpose.zh: 练前臂把手掌翻过来的力量，换手时手掌能转到位再落地
purpose.en: Builds the forearm strength to turn your palm, so your hand lands the right way when you switch hands.

text.zh: 前臂贴住大腿不动，只把手掌翻过来
text.en: Forearm stays on your thigh, just turn your palm

text.zh: 握住小哑铃中间，掌心朝上，慢慢翻到掌心朝下，再慢慢翻回来，一来一回算一次。
text.en: Hold a light dumbbell in the middle, palm up; slowly turn it palm down, then slowly back. That's one rep.

text.zh: 手腕别往上翘也别往下勾，像拧门把手一样整个前臂在转。
text.en: Keep the wrist straight, no bending up or down; the whole forearm turns like on a door handle.

text.zh: 想加难度就握住哑铃一端，离重的那头越远越难。
text.en: To make it harder, hold one end of the dumbbell; the farther from the heavy end, the harder.

commonErrors.zh: 手肘离开大腿，整条胳膊跟着转
commonErrors.en: Lifting your elbow off your thigh and turning the whole arm.

commonErrors.zh: 甩着哑铃借劲，一下翻过去
commonErrors.en: Swinging the dumbbell over in one go.
Only turning halfway before coming back.

cautions.zh: 没有哑铃用锤子或水瓶也行
cautions.en: No dumbbell? A hammer or water bottle works.

training.source: thomas-sup r2 animation tempo (8 s per rep: turn down 2.8 s, hold 0.8 s, turn back 3.2 s, palm up 1.2 s)

thomasSupplement.camera: 正前方特写（看手掌翻转）
thomasSupplement.doseBrief: 2–3 组 × 每侧 10–12 次（一来一回算 1 次）
thomasSupplement.note: defaultDose takes the low end of the brief range; the range is in doseBrief. r2: one rep 8 s (down 2.8 s, hold 0.8 s, back 3.2 s, palm up 1.2 s); close-up from the front. r3: the animation holds a standard dumbbell in the middle with the dedicated grip hand (accepted fixed dumbbell fist); holding one end is now the harder option in cue4.

reminders.zh: 前臂贴住大腿，只翻手掌
reminders.en: Forearm stays down, only the palm turns

reminders.zh: 手腕伸平，整条前臂在转
reminders.en: Wrist stays flat, the whole forearm turns

sides.note: 一侧全部组做完再换边
